decision: version numbers assigned at approve; one open proposal per policy; new documents supersede it
why: published history stays dense and a diff base can never go stale

decision: every new document produces a proposal even when the change set is empty
why: skipping empty diffs would re-extract the same document on every check

decision: synchronous check with short source-row lock transactions instead of a queue or lease
why: smallest design that stays correct; concurrent checks only waste work, unique constraints keep state correct

decision: added a fifth tool save_triage
why: sendMessage returns nothing, so a mode's result must come through a Zod-validated tool call

decision: pinned TypeScript 5.9 and vitest 4 instead of the newest majors
why: vitest 5 is outside the @mastra/evals peer range and TypeScript 7 is the first release of the native compiler

decision: encoded the lifecycle in Postgres: one open proposal per policy, one version per document, status field checks, composite market keys, and triggers that freeze decided versions and change sets
why: the approve gate and immutability should not depend on every code path remembering them
result: migrations apply to anumat and anumat_test; rerun is a no-op

decision: server listens on port 4471 with health, readiness, bearer auth, and a rate-limit stub
why: an uncommon port avoids clashes; auth and limits wrap every /v1 route

decision: US schema checks code format per system (CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS) and keeps all-or-any criteria logic
why: malformed or invented codes should fail Zod before anything is stored
result: 6 rejection cases pass with exact issue paths

decision: diff is a pure function in the US market module, keyed by code identity and normalized text
why: reviewers and evals need a change set that reproduces exactly

decision: outline splits markdown on headings into nested sections; readSections returns chosen sections under a character budget
why: policy markdown is 170K to 400K chars and the model must read sections by id

decision: anydoc first; on needsOcr use Firecrawl Parse only when FIRECRAWL_API_KEY is set, else fail that document with ocr_not_configured

result: all 115 gold codes appear in their excerpts; UHC adult indication matches source line 38

decision: propose, approve, and reject each lock the source row; propose parses with the market schema before any write; approve asserts the base is still the latest approved
why: keeps approve correct under races and makes Zod-before-persist structural
result: 5 lifecycle tests pass on real Postgres incl. concurrent approvals and the trigger

decision: stored created_at at millisecond precision in a new migration

why: headless runs, id-based tools, and a single source for mode to tool and model mapping
result: 5 agent tests pass with scripted models

decision: tools capture validated results; the pipeline persists them after the run
why: keeps lifecycle writes in one place and lets evals run the same job without Postgres
